scope: These checks judge the OFFLINE god-view map artifact (one composed PNG: a labeled grid of every zone's full tile map, a header strip of persisted counters, seal-state stamps, a home marker). It is a reference artifact, not a gameplay frame: no creatures, no HUD bars, no controls strip are expected. Judge legibility and honesty of the world state it claims to show.

checks.check: Fourteen labeled zone panels are present (ZONE 1 through ZONE 8, HUB 1, BASEMENT 1, BASEMENT 2, DUNGEON 1, TEST 1, TEST 2), each showing a full tile grid distinct from the dark backing - no panel is empty, cropped, or duplicated.

Within each panel, walls read against floor tiles and each zone's palette differs from its neighbors - the panels read as different places, not copies. Zone identities match their ratified in-game reads: ZONE 1/ZONE 2 warm clay/bone; ZONE 3 cold slate-and-indigo; ZONE 5 drowned dark green-teal; ZONE 7 a green meadow-with-town; ZONE 8 a forest-and-lake green family with a large water mass clearly distinct from its land; the FLOOR -1 panels (BASEMENT 1/2, DUNGEON 1) read darker than the surface zones (depth darkens palettes).

Inside ZONE 7's town half, a small ring of tiles in a visibly DIFFERENT family from the surrounding meadow encircles one gold way (the drained well basin and its opened hole) - it reads as an authored feature, not corruption or a rendering hole. At map scale the ring is small; judge presence and distinctness, not prominence.

Every seal-gated way carries a SEALED or OPEN text stamp; OPEN stamps sit in the gate-gold family and SEALED stamps in the plain chrome tone, and at least one of each state is legible in this artifact.
Exactly ONE panel is framed with the bright white home border and its label carries the HOME suffix - the home zone is unambiguous at a glance.
The top header strip reads BANKED N / MARKS K / POTIONS P / BOSS 1 DEFEATS D with legible numerals, matching flat placeholder register (no fiction names anywhere in the artifact).
No tearing, no corrupted tiles, no text drawn over text illegibly, no obviously missing glyphs.
